title: Dev-from-backlog stream template
description: Ship the first stream template (FR-TPL-001, first entry of FR-STR-004): pick the next ready ledger row, compile a Work Order, run it at the configured tier, open a PR. The template library framework arrives in WS-P3-001.
acceptance: fw stream add -f with this template creates a stream that picks the next ready row
A run produces a PR and an evidence bundle on a fixture repo
The template contains no vendor names
core_adaptation: This is the dev-from-backlog workstream of Core; WIP limit 2 per project.
